Object.Name: EXACT Calibration Status
Object.Description1: Contains the current status and results of the calibration process, including pre- and post-adjustment values, reference values, and active calibration index.

Item.Name: Status
Item.Description: Status of the current calibration. Non-idle while the calibration is ongoing. Possible values: 0: Idle, 1: Pre-calibration value check, 2: Calibration in progress, 3: Post-calibration value check, 4: Data upload

Item.Name: Result
Item.Description: Result of the last performed calibration. Possible values: 0: Initial value/no status, 1: Calibration success, 2: Reserved (unused), 3: Calibrator ambient temperature out of range, 4: Calibration unsuccessful (post-calibration reference temperature out of tolerance), 5: Battery low, 6: Calibrator ambient sensor could not be read, 7: Device ambient temperature out of range, 8: Calibrator offset/zero resistor out of range, 9: Calibrator high reference resistor out of range, 10: Calibrator switch would not actuate, 11: No calibrator detected, 12: Calibrator serial number missing or invalid, 13: Failed to store calibration coefficients, 14: Calibration session timed out. See resource 7 for the measured value and violated range. Two conditions deliberately have no code of their own: an unreadable device ambient sensor (reported as NaN in resource 9, since not every board has one) and a sensor ADC read error (indistinguishable from a valid negative reading; it surfaces as code 9 instead).

Item.Name: Pre-adjustment values
Item.Description: Pre-adjustment values for all device ports at reference temperatures

Item.Name: Post-adjustment values
Item.Description: Post-adjustment values for all device ports at reference temperatures

Item.Name: Reference values
Item.Description: The list of reference temperatures for the pre- and post-adjustment values

Item.Name: Active Calibration
Item.Description: Index of the calibration that is currently in use

Item.Name: Error detail
Item.Description: Free-form troubleshooting detail for the result in resource 2: the value measured and the range it violated. Empty when the calibration succeeded. Examples: "CAL_AMB t=32.10 range=18.00..28.00", "SW6 adc=3200 range=3914..4114 ports=[3201,3199,3205,3198]", "NVS write 'offset' err=-5". Intended for human diagnosis; resource 2 remains the authoritative result.

Item.Name: Calibrator ambient temperature
Item.Description: Ambient temperature measured by the calibrator's onboard sensor at the time of the calibration run. NaN if the sensor could not be read.

Item.Name: Device ambient temperature
Item.Description: Ambient temperature measured by the device's own onboard sensor at the time of the calibration run. Reported alongside resource 8 so a drifting device sensor can be told apart from a drifting calibrator. NaN if the sensor could not be read, which is informational only: not every board carries a working ambient sensor, so an unreadable one does not fail the calibration.
